event.title: Aavisakar 2026
event.venue: Silver Oak University, Main Campus, Ahmedabad
event.description: Aavisakar is Silver Oak University's flagship annual innovation and technology festival. Featuring 24-hour hackathons, hands-on workshops, keynote talks by industry leaders, cultural showcases, and exciting competitions — two days of creativity, learning, and celebration for 25,000+ students across 17 colleges.

highlights.title: 24-Hour Hackathon
highlights.description: Build innovative solutions to real-world problems. Open to all branches. Prizes worth ₹2,00,000 powered by SOU's Incubation Center.

highlights.title: 30+ Workshops
highlights.description: Hands-on sessions on AI, Blockchain, Cloud Computing, IoT, Robotics, and Full-Stack Development led by industry experts and SOU faculty.

highlights.title: Rangmanch & Cultural Fest
highlights.description: Theatre, dance, Raas Rasiya, fashion show, and live performances celebrating the vibrant cultural spirit of Silver Oak University.
